avis.titre: I use this all the time
avis.texte: I have used a toner for years instead of washing my face with a cleanser in the morning. I rinse with water and then use this to balance and add moisture before starting my other products. This can be hard to find, so grab it while you can. I have mature dry-ish skin.

I wash my face with an oil cleanser at night and use this in the AM to just get any leftover lotions/potions off my face and start off with a fresh canvas. I dont wear foundation/concealer, so i dont need much to prep for the day again, and this is the perfect hydrating toner for my sensitive skin.

Finally decided to give this toner a try since I love the Cerave hydrating cleanser and my usual Korean toner is much more expensive at Ulta (Some By Mi Panthenol Repair Toner), so I thought I could trust this one instead for my sensitive, rosacea prone, and fungal acne prone skin but boy was I wrong. Unfortunately, it took me too long to realize that this toner was what was causing me some sort of allergic reaction that made my skin very itchy and my eyelids puffy / inflamed even when avoiding the general eye area. It took stripping my routine down to a gentle cleanser + moisturizer for a couple of weeks to finally experience some relief. The first thing I added back in was this Cerave hydrating toner and almost instantly the itchiness and eye irritation returned - such a nightmare! Unfortunately, I used about a 1/4 of the product before I realized this was the culprit and don't think I can return it anymore but boy do I wish I could. This product is a hard NO for me in the future.
Wanted to like it. I have easy skin, doesnt take much to take care of and i do not break out. Maybe a pimple near my cycle but ive tried this twice and I broke out both times. Its a no for me

I use oil or balm cleansers. They work well for removing makeup and cleaning my sensitive skin. I wanted something to remove any left over makeup and hydrate my skin as a first step-in my morning and night routines. This does exactly what I wanted. CeraVe products work well on my skin. I was going to buy an expensive toner that I've used in the past, but decided to try this. For my older skin, this does not replace moisturizer, but it takes the after-cleansing dryness away instantly. I'm very pleased and will repurchase this product when I run. out. I recommend it. It doesn't not contain any ingredients that will harm the skin.

avis.titre: This is the Best by Far!
avis.texte: Am on my second bottle of this facial toner and I've been using this toner since I graduate high school and this is my absolute favorite!

This has helped my skin look its best. my skin is glowy & moisturized after a shower. i use my face wash, this product, then hyaluronic acid and moisturizer and it's been the perfect combination. will continue to buy over and over!!!!

I use this day and night after cleansing. It is so hydrating and helps reduce redness in my cheeks. I use several layers before applying my serums and moisturizer. It's been a total game changer in my skincare routine and helps my very dry skin retain moisture.

avis.titre: Great for skin flooding for Sensitive skin
avis.texte: Great for skin flooding as it has a pure-liquid consistency. Perfect for my sensitive skin - there's no burning or any irritation, even when applying multiple layers. Definitely keeping in my routine.

I question if it really is alcohol-free because when I apply it, there is a strong alcohol scent. A little got in my eyes and it burns. It is somewhat hydrating but not long term. I will not repurchase and most likely return.
I have been using this product for almost 5 years and I love it. My skin looks very good, sometimes during the summer I don't even have to use my face moisturizer.

avis.titre: Hydrating. Definitely a repeat Purchase for me.
avis.texte: This is the first toner I've used which is incredibly hydrating on my very sensitive skin. It removes any excess make-up remaining after cleansing and washing. Definitely a repeat purchase for me.
My face started breaking out in these weird bumps when I started using it. I typically don't break out much unless my period is on the way. Once I stopped using it my skin returned to normal

This toner gently removes all dirt & grime without striping skin. Its amazing what is left on your skin even after washing. I use it on my face, neck, shoulders, chest & sometimes arms. It removes all the city grossness.
I was hoping for even milder toner if possible. It still feels like it stings a bit on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Great for price and for sensitive dry skin
avis.texte: Loved trying this out and adding it to my skincare i used it morninf and night right before going in with other toners and serums :)

I really wanted to love this because the reviews are so good, but I didnt have a good experience with this toner. This is the first toner I've purchased, but it was extremely drying and almost immediately I noticed small red bumps all over my forehead and cheeks. I tried to use it a few more times thinking my skin was purging, but it definitely was not! No more hives since I stopped using this. But everyone's skin is different, just be cautious before purchasing this.

This is my absolute favorite toner! I have tried a bunch of different toners from various brands, but this is my favorite one! It is super hydrating, doesn't have any fragrance, and doesn't leave a film on my skin! I would 100% recommend this product!

i've been using a combo of peach and lily and sunday riley products for about a year now, and can usually count on cerave when I can usually cera ve for a backup/budget replacement for one of my products when i'm on more of a budget. this was my first time trying this toner though, and it left such a sticky, almost greasy residue on my skin. I powered through it, until about a week in my skin started breaking out into a bunch of white heads! upon further inspection, my face was full of clogged pores!! I was pretty close to "glass skin" so this is a MAJOR disappointment.

I damaged my skin barrier from using 10% BHA/Panoxyl & this product got my skin back looking normal (& maybe even better than before) in less than a week! So glad I bought this... idk if I can even live without it now!

avis.titre: Sticky, burning sensation, and then, an eczema patch
avis.texte: Left my face sticky, then few applications later I felt my skin burn and now I have a dry patch under my eye,which turns out to be eczema. learned my lesson.I use 2 tea spoons cold milk and a cotton ball to cleanse, rinse with water, moisturize.done
I have sensitive skin and this toner works well on my skin. Super light, no breakouts after using it, and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean.

avis.titre: My breakouts gone for just a week
avis.texte: This is my holy grail product. Ive been breaking out for over two years and I did go to dermatalogist and nothing happened to my skin until I found this product. And its just a snap, Ive noticed skin getting better everyday until all my pimples gone.. And now Im free from breakout..
I use this mornings instead of using a cleanser. No scent and hydrating.
Seemed like water to me. Dont get me wrong, I love the brand but this product showed no signs of improvement on my skin. My skin felt maybe a little more hydrated but thats it.

Great, budget friendly option I tried on a fluke and actually enjoy. I breakout sometimes and have combo skin but this seems to maintain my skin health and the ingrediants are relatively clean which i always like! def recommend it
I love this toner for my dry slightly break out prone skin. I use it with all CeraVe products for dry sensitive skin and it controls breakouts well.
It cleared all the tiny dark bumpa on my forehead, like closed commodones. It also helped reduce my scaring. It's a perfecr product for people with dry skin too.
It leaves a sticky film on my face. I will finish the bottle but doubt I'd repurchase it.

avis.titre: Help me achieve the dewy skin look
avis.texte: I have found this toner helpful in acheiving the dewy skin/glass skin look. It provides a boost of hydration and additional cleansing. Even though i have combo/oily skin, this product doesnt feel heavy or clog my pores.
Find myself repurchasing again and again. Its a staple in my skin care regimen. Great for sensitive, combo skin.
Love this toner! I have sensitve skin that's prone to breakouts and this hasn't let me down yet. I've repurchased like 3 times and will continue to buy.

this toner definitely lives up to its name, its very hydrating and probably a little to much for me because it made me look pretty oily throughout the day, however something that does not make me use it anymore is the fact that it broke me out pretty bad, in the span of one week using it i got 9 new pimples which is more than i usually get, personally this product is not for me
Hydrating, NON-drying. Great for dry skin. It removes so much excess dirt and remnants that I never realized get left behind after even a great makeup remover balm.

avis.titre: Something everyone should have in their skincare routine....
avis.texte: This is the first step in my skin care routine. I think a toner is really important so that it restores the pH balance of your skin. A lot of ladies and men do not do the step but I think it's a very important one. I'd like to survey hydrating toner just because of the price point you can go out and buy all the expensive toners you want, but this toner is what it is and it's good.
I have dry skin and this has helped very much and my face feels smoother

avis.titre: Didn't work for me, but maybe it will for you
avis.texte: I really love this brand, but sadly :( I wont be buying this again… I have combo skin on warmer climates and then dry skin in colder climates. It did make my face "glowy", the smell is neutral, and it does last you for a long time. However, it was very itchy and I would always feel a burning sensation.

Firstly i would have to say i have tried many toners and they didnt make the cut. This however has proven effective. For the past 2 months i have noticed how much softer, glowy my skin has become since adding this product to my skincare. For once i can say i have achieved "glass" skin.

avis.titre: This toner is very effective and has a nice smell.
avis.texte: I love this toner! It is apart of my daily skincare routine. I always feel so refreshed after using it and I love the smell. It has a water like texture and sinks into your skin nicely.

avis.titre: Currently using in my skin care routine!
avis.texte: The CeraVe Hydrating Toner is a reliable addition to my skincare routine. Its gentle formula effectively removes any remaining traces of dirt and impurities while maintaining the skin's natural moisture balance. I appreciate that it's fragrance-free and non-irritating, making it suitable for sensitive skin like mine. However, I've noticed that it doesn't offer the same level of exfoliation as some other toners on the market, so it might not be the best choice for those looking to target specific skin concerns like dullness or uneven texture. Overall, it's a solid option for everyday use, especially if you're seeking a gentle and hydrating toner for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: This is a great product from a great brand that dermatolo...
avis.texte: I really like this Cerave Hydrating Toner. It is gentle on your skin and leaves it feeling soft and smooth. It has a mild scent. I would recommend this product and will definitely buy it again. ￼

Love that there isn't any scent to this and the ingredients are clean. It feels like you're putting water on your face. I really like how my face feels after I use I just don't like it for removing make up I rather stick to micelar water

This is one of my favorite toners! ( the only toner I use right now) I love it! It's so hydrating but it only lasts me a couple of weeks. The price is super efficient and the packaging is easy to use. It has no smell to it which I love. The ingrediants seem fine. It overall is kind of mid. Like I would recommend but there are better options | I also think it's secretly breaking me out|

avis.titre: I have used 3 bottles of this and I really like it, it ba...
avis.texte: I have used the 3rd bottle of toner from this brand, the product has a gentle, pleasant scent, dries quickly when applied to the skin, balances the PH level very well, I like to use it after washing my face, it absorbs very quickly and my skin Looks firmer, simple design, easy to use and maintain, and the price is also cheap compared to the market

I have repurchased this toner several times and will continue to do so. It is a nice, gentle product for sensitive skin that helps to hydrate and remove excess debris after washing your face. It is scentless and not drying at all.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way so you dont need much for it to ...
avis.texte: The product is very nice it makes my face feel so nice after moisturizing, the smell is not strong & it's has NO alcohol which is a huge thing, The product is very small so its easy to travel with i would highly recommend for dry skin

avis.titre: A Toner for your budget and face
avis.texte: This toner is budget friendly and does deliver. It did not dry my face abd it's light and soft on skin.
I love this toner! Usually toners dry my skin out but this one is hydrating just like it says! it's a must have product especially in winter! i will definitely buy again when i run out.
Wonderful product for sensitive skin that needs hydration. Leaves the skin soft and moisturized.Very mild scent and very basic but eye pleasing packaging.
I have acne prone skin and this toner helps calm my skin. I can tell the difference when I use it vs when don't use it.
i've ruined my skin barrier a few times, and was always able to bounce back pretty quickly with this! great for sensitive skin

avis.titre: This product single-handedly saved my skin.
avis.texte: I am on a prescription retinoid. Any of you who also use one know exactly what I was dealing with... next level irritation. No matter what combination of serums and moisturizers I used, I couldn't quite repair my barrier. Just the simple addition of using this toner immediately after washing and before any other product, gave my skin that extra protection and boost of hydration. It made a world of difference... please never discontinue or change this toner! It's perfection!!

avis.titre: My unexpected key to glass skin
avis.texte: As someone with oily skin, this toner has helped me acheive the dewy/glass skin look. It hydrates intensely which helps blunt my face's usual inclination to produce way too much oil. The result is a crisp, luminouus face that looks more refreshed and healthy than my usual oily shine.

Had a facial and the esthetician advised using a toner as part of my routine. Saw the Cerave and gave it a try. What a difference it has made! My 55yo face is shiny and soft. The toner doesn't sting or have an awful scent. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Feels nice but not very sensitive
avis.texte: Overall CeraVe products have been a lifesaver for my skin! Was pumped about this toner, and it feels okay when you first use it, but for me, it caused the worst rosacea flare up I've ever had, that immediately got better once I stopped using it. :(

This toner does the trick with hydration! But my skin doesn't stay hydrated for too long. However, I think it's worth the price and I imagine it works great for dry skin. I have combination skin and it works well. I probably won't be buying it again, but I'd recommend it to someone who needs an affordable hydration product.

This will be my 2nd bottle purchasing, and I will continue to repurchase. For it being under $10 is great. Immediately adds hudration into my skin and leave it feeling hydrated, I also like to pair with hyaluronic acid serum.
I used it for two days later and it burns my skin. I don't recommend it.

I have a eczema prone and extremely dry, sensitive skin since I was a newborn baby. I used Cerave Hydrating Cleanser and Cetaphil Extra Gentle Daily Scrub, Cerave Hydrating Toner, Cerave Moisturizing Cream every night! In the morning, I saw a difference! My face is glowing!!! I'm a man who doesn't need to wear makeup anymore! I love my skincare products!!! :)

avis.titre: LOVE 💚…..(wish this came in a larger size 😔)
avis.texte: I love this toner. I use it after cleansing with my La Rosche Posay Hydrating cleanser and it gives my skin that extra hydration, especially in the winter months when my skin in drier. It also removes any residue left behind from cleansing. I have mature EXTREMELY sensitive skin that reacts to almost everything (very prone to breakouts) and also I am very oily and I still use hydrating products and my skin drinks them up. I always used to by products that would strip my oily skin of its natural oils and as I matured learned that hydration is key - even with oily skin. 🩷💜💕

To give you an idea of how sensitive and reactive my skin is, I cannot even use a cotton round to apply this. I have to use my hands to gently pat it in. But this is the only toner I will ever use again, and I've tried brands that were 5x the price for almost half the volume. Most "hydrating" toners or mists simply feel like evaporated water once on the skin - nothing. This product, however, leaves the loveliest light, dewy texture. It is the perfect prep for the rest of my skincare routine day and night. I wish Cerave would offer a spray cap, as I'd love to be able to mist it!
I didn't give 5 stars because I feel like it leaves my skin a little sticky. I do think it's helped with my issue of dry flaking.

i have normal/clear skin & was super excited to try out this toner. however, it burns when you first apply (even w/ damp skin & a small amount) it's too hydrating & throughout the day it caused my skin to look super greasy/oily, also it made my face feel extremely dirty as if it was a humid day outside. and lastly it broke me out just a little bit & i only used it for 3 days, thank god i stopped and my face has cleared up. AVOID & invest in a better toner!
Best toner I have found. Wish I would have found it sooner. Very nice on mature skin.

I've always struggled to find a toner that works for me but this has quickly become my go to product. My skin is very sensitive, so I do my best to mostly avoid fragrances and alcohol in my skincare. This checks all the boxes.

avis.titre: Love but the bottle is small
avis.texte: Works great, but the bottle is so small you go through it really fast
worked for the first two days but then it started burning really bad to the point of tears
Very nice toner! Did not strip the moisture from my skin! It was left plump and soft!

Absolutely love this product. Hard to find so going to buy multiple bottles. You can feel the extra layer of hydration. For a toner this is the best one I have tried and not irritating my sensitive skin. Recommended by doctorly on youtube video.
Love this toner! Just wished it came in a bigger size. Leaves my skin feeling refreshed after wiping with the micellar water & washing with the SA cleanser

I very have oily skin but once in a while itll feel a bit dry. My mom got me this for my birthday, its definitely hydrating like it says! I feel like its a little too much for my skin, I was hoping it wouldnt be. I started to use it every other day and that has seemed to help though! This would be amazing for people with dry skin!

I love this Toner, it's very soothing and hydrating. It leaves my skin fresh, even when my very sensitive skin is irritated, does not stings or burns like other products do. Please, don't ever discontinue it!
It's impossible to order this item outside of the USA. As I don't use products without toner (by skin just feels very dry then), I will search for another company.

I bought this on a whim because I was running low on the essence I normally use and wanted something alcohol free, fragrance free, with hylauronic acid and niacinimide that was more cost effective. It's been a week, and this stuff works soooo much better than the 40 dollar essence I was using previously. Idk about the "cleansing" claim since I dont use it on a cotton round and just splash some on my face like I would an essence, but i cannot believe how ridiculously well this has worked on my skin. It's more elastic, significantly less dry, and my pores are tiny. I feel like a 20 year old again. Definitely recommend adding to your skincare routine if you have super dry skin like I do
Switched to this from the Heritage Toner. Love them both but if you're allergic to rose, this is a great alternative. Non-drying.

though this is marketed for sensitive skin, this contains phenoxyethanol, which is a preservative/stabilizer known to be associated with reactions from eczema to threatening allergic reactions. no wonder this gave me contact dermatitis! this ingredient is on a list of top screening allergens associated with cosmetics - obviously this is used in cosmetics at safe concentrations, but it is good to know if a product contains an ingredient that is a common allergen for many people.

i have sensitive combination skin and have used this toner for 3.5 days, morning and night. it was pleasant to put on - though i only used it for a short period of time, my skin felt plump after applying and it wasn't drying (though i don't think i noticed it was noticeably hydrating). i have previously only used exfoliating toners before so it was exciting to add this hydrating toner. however, on the night of the 3rd day using it, i passively noticed having some bumps/texture on my face, and the next day i noticed it was all over my face and neck (where i've applied this). unfortunately this definitely has given me contact dermatitis, which is surprising because i've tried/used a lot of different skincares, many that don't market itself for sensitive skin, so i will try to return this and try to figure out what ingredient(s) in this have caused me problems while other things i have tried hasn't. i guess this is just a good lesson to always patch test, even if a product claims to be safe for sensitive skin!

idk why but this product dried my skin out so much. i love the cerave hydrating cream to foam cleaner so i thought this would be a natural pairing, but it left my skin dry in patches and flakey. nothing else in my routine changed so i know it's this…. sad :(
i have very sensitive skin, like whatever id use would irritate and give me a baddd reaction to it. so, i tried out this and it works so well.
I JUST RECENTLY STARTED USING A TONER AND THOUGHT I WOULD TRY THIS. IT DOES NOT DRY OUT THE SKIN AND WORKS GREAT WITH MY VERY SENSITIVE SKIN. IT WAS ON SALE TOO WHICH WAS A PLUS!!

avis.titre: Have stuck to your face cleanser for awhile now! !
avis.texte: Haven't used it yet! Will buy it! Use cleanser! and nighttime and day creams! Verrry dry skin alllll over! Always said I should buy stock in a body lotion because I buy so much!! Problem is , I have to change brand all the time!!
This toner refreshes your skin. I pair it with the cetacean wash and the results are amazing. Leaves my skin glowing and soft. Highly recommend!
I really enjoyed this toner, it wasn't drying to the skin and it had no smell. but I don't feel like it really hydrated my face too much tho.

I never leave reviews but I just had to because I want the people at CeraVe to NEVER STOP making this product. I bought this on a whim and I'm so glad I did because I love this toner, it's so hydrating. Perfect for my dry skin. Doesn't do too much or too little. It feels good on application, very gentle like water. I apply it to damp skin and my skin soaks it right up. I use this every single time after I wash my face. It's quickly become a staple in my routine. And the ingredients are also great. I have nothing bad to say about this brand and this toner is no exception. Just excellent. Highly recommend if you have dry skin and need that extra hydration in your routine.
Awesome toner, hydrates without oiliness and keeps my skin balanced.

Really wanted to love this toner, but way too sticky. I am sure it is great for normal/dry skin types. Love Cerave products, but not this toner. Please make a gentle matte toner for oily/combo/sensitive skin types. Looking for a toner that is very gentle with light moistuizing and dissolves oil during the day, i.e. matte.

avis.titre: Amazing Toner for Sensitive Dry Skin
avis.texte: Noticed most toners are too stripping for my dry skin. Been through a couple bottles of this and my skin has done well, think it's a great prep for my serums and moisturizers.

It did make my skin feel soo soft but it caused me to break out around my cheeks and chin :( i have really dry skin during the winter and i was hoping this toner would work as other irritated my skin and i'm sadden that this one did as well. it burnt and made my skin itch after applying.

This toner was very hydrating. I have oily skin and my partner has dry. My face felt super hydrated after and had a complete glassy dewy skin look (cleanse>astringent toner>this toner>moisturizer), and my partner's skin was not as glassy, but the most dewy/glassy that I've ever seen it. Asian beauty fans with my skin type might really like the glassy look, but I toned it down a little bit on the moisturizer after and got a much more natural dewy look the next morning. Yes, there are products out there that will do much more than this, but for the price point it's pretty darn good. I use the dickinson's witch hazel hydrating toner as my astringent toner, and this cerave one is waaaaay more hydrating. You can expect more texture and thickness from this one compared to a watery toner, but that is only natural. Anyone who has experience in facial hydration knows the texture it leaves on your skin; it's not supposed to feel like just water.
This is a great toner with Hydrating toner. Will purchase again
This is the first time I've tried this brand, and it's very nice.
Pretty good toner so far it's rlly not bad at all it made my skin feel hydrated and kind of gave it a glow and the price is pretty good

I have oily combo skin. I don't need a special toner—just anything that will hydrate my skin enough. This does the job. It's gentle, quick-absorbing, easily accessible (can be found in many drugstores), and cheap; a good basic, especially for beginners. However, since the toner is designed for dry skin, it does end up feeling heavy/sticky for me, especially since I live in a humid climate. I make sure to just layer it on once. For people with sensitive, dry skin, this toner will prob be your holy grail. But, for me, it's a good enough toner—not my fav tho. Hopefully, cerave will make a toner for people of my skin type.

avis.titre: Love Love Love everything in this bottle
avis.texte: I am a firm believer in toner and essence! I think that any product that come in a liquid form just gonna absorbed quicker than serum or cream. As I am getting older I notice my skin just dont love thicker product and have trouble getting everything to absorb. This is a great product with Niaciamide and ceramide to calm my skin while im on my period and hydrating at the same time. Highly recommended
Left my face and neck feeling sticky. I will not purchase again. Product was not refreshing at all. I will return to purchasing Dickinson's Enhanced Witch Hazel Hydrating Toner with Rosewater.

This product leaves my skin feeling sticky. I will not purchase again. It's not at all refreshing. I will definitely go back to purchasing Dickinson's Enhanced Witch Hazel Hydrating Toner with Rosewater.
I wish I could upload photos but it won't let me. I have a red drying rash on my cheeks and on the corners of my mouth. It made my skin feel super tight and itchy while having my moisturizer on.
I love this toner. It does not leave a residue on my skin after using and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and ready to go. It is lightweight and not oily or greasy. I definitely recommend.
It is very hydrating product I have oily skin so I use it at night and wake up to hydrated skin ! So if you have oily skin I'd use it at night you'll get real oily during the day .

avis.titre: It's okay but it could be more
avis.texte: The CeraVe Hydrating Toner softens my skin after use. It has hyaluronic acid, which helps with moisture protection. In addition, the niaciamide helps calm my skin after cleansing. Lastly, I appreciate that the product is fragrance free, non-comedogenic and balances my pH level. However, I have other toners that takes this concept to the next level. This is a simple, everyday toner but I don't think it's something I would re-purchase because there are other toners that provide more benefits to my skin.
I love using this toner especially since my skin is getting super dry because of the cold. I use it after cleansing with a cotton pad and I love that it has niacinamide and hyaluronic acid in it.

I loved the idea of ​​adding the CeraVe Hidratong Toner to my skincare list because the difference is great as it leaves my skin smooth to absorb the moisturizer from my skincare cream. I recommend that you use the toner as part of your skin care routine and the results will be incredible.
The crave hydrating toner is really good! It has a very light scent, and leaves your face hydrated!!
I used The cerave hydrating toner and I have dry skin and this left my skin feeling hydrated and removed leftover residue from my face. I like how it's also alcohol free.
This tinder is absolutely amazing. It goes on nicely on my face and definitely leaves my face cleaner and takes off so much dirt it's unbelievable

Thank you CeraVe! Finally a product that strips down the day to day build up without leaving my skin so dry and thirsty. This toner removes all makeup, and ensures I'm clean, hydrated yet not oily and it's been a dream!! Would not change it. This is a must!

avis.titre: Great toner but not going to be in my everyday routine
avis.texte: I do like this toner for its moisturizing properties. I have extremely sensitive skin and this toner does irritate it a little bit. If I'm having a flare up, this toner does sting, and the smell of it is slightly off-putting. However, when my skin is having a good day, I like to use this toner after washing my face. It helps keep my skin from flaking or having *too* prominent of dry patches throughout the day or after a long night of sleep. Makeup tends to cling to my dry patches, but since I started using this toner prior to moisturizing and applying makeup, the dry patches are less prominent and my makeup actually stays longer throughout the day.
This toner is perfect after washing my face or removing my makeup. It doesn't dry my face. However, it seems to keep my face matte. It doesn't seem to get excessively oily as the day goes on.

I loved this toner. I really feel how it cleanses the pores and helps my skin stay healthier and free of impurities. It's perfect because it's fragrance-free. It contains niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. It leaves my skin hydrated and without the sensation of dryness. My skin is oily but I also have areas with dryness, and this toner really helps a lot!

This toner is very gentle and not at all stripping. Most toners contain exfoliating acids that can be harsh on the skin barrier. This toner does not leave my skin feeling tight, dry, or stripped. I use it nightly.
I have been using this toner every morning applied to a cotton pad. It works really great and keeps my skin moisturized especially as it is winter now.

I absolutely love this toner. I have very dry and sensitive skin, so toners are usually too harsh for me. This one leaves my skin so smooth and hydrated. It has actually helped my dry skin issues instead of making it worse. Highly recommend this!

So my teenagers use CeraVe and have said it is great to use so of course I decided to try the products. And I must say when I use the Hyrdating Toner for the first time it was nice and cool to my skin as if I was in a spa getting a facial.

What I do like about this product is that is gentle alcohol-free, includes hyaurolonic acid and niaciamide along with ceramides to protect and restore the skin barrier , it definitely made my skin feel better after too many drying products although I'm not convinced on the efficacy of this to remove all makeup but it's a great addition to your routine prior to using a serum

I'm completely amazed at how well this worked for my skin. I have noticed good improvement these past few weeks since adding this toner to my skincare routine.
